description: Ordered op lists through runSearch. One op list is one case, and the ops share the cache, the per-provider gap and a virtual clock that starts at 1000000 ms. Each step records the outcome, the providers called in order (called) and the virtual milliseconds waited (waitedMs). Responses are canned per provider id. The cache cases fill it past its 80-entry limit: the oldest answer goes first, a hit does not move an entry, and an expired answer that is fetched again takes the newest slot.
